newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Steniel board elects new company president.
newsitem.headline: Steniel board elects new company president.

text.p: The board of Steniel Manufacturing Corp, a unit of Metro Pacific Corp, has elected Augusto Palisoc Jr as new company president and chief executive officer effective January 1, 1997, the company said on Monday.
In a disclosure to the Philippine Stock Exchange, the company said Palisoc will replace Gilberto Vendiola who will leave the company effective October 31.
Palisoc will be acting president from November 1 to December 31 while relocating from his present position as group vice president for corporate development of First Pacific Company Ltd.
